<!--
Please describe the problem you are trying to solve, not only the interface you
want. There may be a simpler way to solve the same problem, and it helps us
agree on the goal before you invest in a specific solution.

If you have already written code for this, open a pull request and link it here.
-->

## The problem

<!-- What are you trying to do that UniMate does not currently support? -->

## Your proposed solution

<!-- What you have in mind. A sketch, mockup, or description is enough. -->

## Alternatives considered

<!-- Other approaches you have thought about, and why they are worse or not
     better. This helps us tell whether the constraint is the idea or the
     implementation. -->

## Scope check

- [ ] This does not require a backend, an account system, or server-side storage
- [ ] This keeps all user data in the browser (`localStorage`)
- [ ] This does not duplicate something already available under a different name

<!-- UniMate is deliberately a static, client-only app with no backend. Requests
     that break these constraints are usually much larger than they first
     appear, so flag it early rather than building it and finding out. -->

## Additional context

<!-- Mockups, links to similar tools, or examples of what you have in mind. -->
